main: The first {st:SupportAlly} E.G.O allowing you to use it on an ally. Doing so buffs them with {st:Breath}, {st:Charge}, shield, SP, damage mitigation, a single debuff removal, and if they're a {st:PersonalityBreath} or {st:PersonalityCharge}, additional damage. It acts as a standard 3 atk weight damaging E.G.O if you target an enemy instead.
Gains {st:DespairKnightEGOMind} for any damage taken by allies. At 999, the E.G.O does not cost any sin resources, but consumes all stacks of the buff to use.

Each use gives him 1 {st:DespairKnightEGOSword} which increases the damage all of his {st:Charge}, {kw:Pride}, and {kw:Pierce} skills and gives him some {st:Sinking} application. Ally deaths also give a stack.
other: Prevents his attack type resistances from going over 1.5 except when staggered. Takes -30% damage while staggered. The ally he applies {st:DespairKnightEGOProtect} to also gains this effect.
Has Synergies with other Magical Girl identities and E.G.O on the field, increasing their damage dealt.

passiveList.desc:
This unit's Attack Type Resist. that are higher than 1.5 are adjusted to 1.5 (except while Staggered)
If this unit is Staggered, take -30% damage (including forced Staggers)

At 999 [DespairKnightEGOMind], does not consume E.G.O resource when using the "The Sword Sharpened with Tears" E.G.O Skill (both Awakening and Corrosion)

Gain [DespairKnightEGOMind] equal to damage taken by allies (including this unit; including Shield damage)
On Ally Death, gain 1 [DespairKnightEGOSword] (once per turn)
When an ally that has [DespairKnightEGOProtect] is defeated, gain 1 [DespairKnightEGOSword] (once per turn)

Offense Level +1 and Defense Level -1 for every 2 defeated allies (max 5)
passiveList.name: From the Depths of Despair
